Deeper pass on the incident write-up:

1. A top incident analyst would split the errors by tenant, release and time before naming a cause, and line them up against every deploy in the window.
2. Rawest material: logs/checkout.log, not the digest in logs/summary.txt, which sums every tenant into one number.
3. Methods: group errors with scripts/errors_by.sh by tenant and release, then read the deploy line nearest the first error.
4. Outside check: the error counts by release must put the errors on one release and not the others.

Redone: notes/incident.md now names release 4.18.2 on acme-eu, which cut PAYMENTS_TIMEOUT_MS from 3000 to 800. errors_by.sh shows 64 of 67 errors on acme-eu and release 4.18.2.
pass.why: answers all four questions concretely for this incident

Tools: grep and the bundled scripts/errors_by.sh, grouped by tenant then release. Check: rerun errors_by.sh release; if the cause is right, nearly all errors sit on one release.
